notes.title: Beta 0.52 mini update
notes.content:
A mini updating that includes bug fixing and balancing.
[list]
[*]Fixed the bug that fades the screen after loading a saved game
[*]Players now can press key "E" to interact with NPC
[*]Increased the amount of guard in orcs cave
[*]Reduced the limit camera zoom in and added fog to level
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.52 mini balance update
notes.content:
Adjust some balance issues so that the game doesn't end prematurely.
[list]
[*]Extend in-game day time to reduce enemy spawning frequency.
[*]Reduce the health points of goblins from 60 to 45.
[*]Reduce prestige punishment form the death of NPC units.
[/list]
